card.name: Verbs and articles after a subject in descriptive prose
card.fires_on: A word right after a subject or verb in general-knowledge prose about history, science or events, such as a verb of motion or action, or 'the' before a physical noun. It is not drug-label text.

modes.label: Motion verbs
modes.description: A verb of movement or action just after its subject in a narrative or explanation.
modes.example: a piece of foam<< fell>> from a "bipod ramp"

modes.label: Article or noun in physical explanation
modes.description: 'the' or a noun partway through a physical description.
modes.example: When a helicopter moves forward then the blades on one side travel through<< the>> air faster than the blades on the other

modes.label: Words in history and politics
modes.description: A noun or preposition in a clause about conflict or rivalry between groups.
modes.example: whose<< interests>> began to conflict with those of the Romans

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words and place-like terms, so there is no clear effect on English output.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of ordinary encyclopedia-style sentences about events, motion and history.
